newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopian birr weakens against the dollar.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopian birr weakens against the dollar.

text.p: The Ethiopian birr was quoted marginally weaker compared to the dollar on Wednesday, the central National Bank of Ethiopia (NBE) said.
It quoted the birr at a mean rate of 6.6450 against the dollar compared to 6.6210 last week.
The bank posted the birr at a mean rate of 10.9376 against the pound from 10.7328 last week, while against the yen the birr traded at 0.058556 from 0.057477 last week.
